items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the labelled lemma `l:Weinstein` at source lines 715-738: there are neighbourhoods U of the diagonal in Sigma x Sigma and V of the zero section in T*Sigma together with a map psi restricting to a diffeomorphism on the interior, sending the diagonal to the zero section and pulling lambda_std back to nu_2 - nu_1 + d f, with f explicitly normalised on the boundary; in collar coordinates psi has the displayed explicit form. The author's proof (source lines 740-809) is a full two-stage construction: it first writes down the explicit collar model kappa_0 and verifies both the pull-back identity and the two boundary identities for f_0, which is where the constant a_C and the normalised primitive are consumed (lines 741-773); it then extends that model to a neighbourhood of the whole diagonal by choosing f_1 and kappa_1 with prescribed behaviour near the boundary part (lines 775-776), and finishes with a textbook application of Moser's trick in which the orientation comparison lets one solve for X_t, the vanishing properties of X_t are checked, and the exactness computation produces f as an integral of mu_t(X_t) + f_1 along the isotopy (lines 777-808). The statement contains the conclusion and the explicit formula but none of the construction, and the explicit formula is itself part of the statement rather than a hypothesis.
